purpose: Teach: 磯/黒髪/アジサイ/めがね/山菜/乳製品/谷間/偉人

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、磯釣りに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of our customers went shore fishing, apparently.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. A small pause before the name, like offering a thought rather than announcing it. Warm and slightly wistful, trailing softly at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、黒髪が美しい方ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there was a customer with such beautiful dark hair.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Unhurried. A little moment of genuine appreciation in the voice. Not performing — just noticing something lovely and sharing it naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前にアジサイを植えたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we should plant hydrangeas out front of the shop.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently suggestive. A small lift at the end — not commanding, more like she's imagining it aloud. Warm invitation to imagine it together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新しいめがねが似合ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of our customers looked so nice in their new glasses.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine appreciation. The words settle lightly. A small smile underneath. No flourish — just noticing and sharing what was seen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに山菜の天ぷら加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we should add mountain vegetable tempura to the new menu.
lines.style: Brighter energy. A little more momentum in the suggestion. Engaged and present. The spark of an idea she wants to bring to life with her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、乳製品アレルギーなんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of our customers has a dairy allergy, apparently.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause. The information lands with quiet importance. A tone that says: this matters, remember this. Gentle, not alarmist. Caring in the details.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、谷間にある秘湯へ旅行されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of our customers went on a trip to a hot spring hidden in a valley.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreaming quality. The words unfold slowly. There's something lovely in the image — she's sharing it like a small gift. Trailing warmly at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、地域の偉人を研究なさってるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently one of our customers is researching local figures of importance.
lines.style: Quiet observation with a note of respect underneath. Gentle, unhurried delivery. A small fade at the very end — like she's sitting with the thought.
